components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;width:170px;padding:10px 10px 14px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(165deg,#251c33,#1b1526);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-color 320ms,box-shadow 320ms;font-family:inherit;color:#efe7dd}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.8);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 24px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c9a227;outline-offset:2px}.ds-sheen{position:absolute;top:-30%;left:-30%;width:60%;height:160%;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 40%,rgba(229,207,122,.2) 50%,transparent 60%);transform:skewX(-18deg) translateX(-80%);opacity:0;transition:none}.ds-card:hover .ds-sheen{animation:ds-sweep .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}@keyframes ds-sweep{0%{transform:skewX(-18deg) translateX(-80%);opacity:0}15%{opacity:1}100%{transform:skewX(-18deg) translateX(340%);opacity:0}}.ds-art{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;border-radius:8px;background:radial-gradient(120px 90px at 50% 45%,rgba(201,162,39,.12),transparent 78%);transition:transform 600ms}.ds-card:hover .ds-art{transform:scale(1.06)}.ds-name{margin-top:8px;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.35}.ds-meta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:8px;align-items:center}.ds-badge{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);background:rgba(212,175,55,.08);color:#e5cf7a}.ds-no{color:#8b808f;font-size:.7rem}

narrative.overview: The codex is a dark Heian display case: game data set into night-lacquer surfaces with gilded edges, where each shikigami is an ema plaque and color itself means rarity. Density is high, ornament is scarce and always load-bearing. Motion is expressive choreography — staggered reveals, rarity-conditioned sheen, staged modal entrances — all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Rarity is the color system, carried on full hairlines
Deep warm neutrals carry the ground; vermilion and gold are seals, not palettes
Marcellus display over Mincho prose; system sans for data
Every surface answers hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading and error

rules.name: The Full Hairline Rule
rules.body: Rarity uses a complete 1px border at 30% tint brightening to 80% on hover — never a one-sided colored bar.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Vermillion appears as a fill on at most one interaction point per viewport. Gold never fills; it traces.

rules.name: The Twice-Sized Rule
rules.body: Display type is at least 2.5x the body size; section heads never shrink to bold body text.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: If separation can be a 1px border and a tone step, it is; a shadow must answer a state.

dos: Compose translucent accents from rgb(var(--<color>-rgb) / a) triplet tokens
Keep every animation under the .js-fx opt-in and the prefers-reduced-motion fallback
Size art with natural aspect (heroFit); art files are WebP-as-png with transparent margins
donts: No emoji or unicode glyphs as icons — all icons are inline drawn SVGs
No native <select>, no one-sided colored borders
No network loads of any kind; attribution stays plain-text in the footer
Never fabricate missing art; use the img-err initial ornament
